items.title: OECD updates MLI arbitration profiles for Australia, Japan, and the Netherlands
items.summary: The OECD has published updated arbitration profiles for the Netherlands, Australia, and Japan under the Multilateral Convention to Implement Tax Treaty Related Measures to Prevent Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (MLI). Part VI of the MLI allows jurisdictions that opt to apply it to use mandatory binding arbitration to resolve tax treaty disputes. The arbitration...

items.title: Azerbaijan, Cambodia agree on tax provisions in draft income tax treaty
items.summary: Azerbaijan’s State Tax Service announced that Azerbaijan has concluded the second negotiation round with Cambodia on 11 September 2026. The two countries reached agreement on all tax-related provisions in their draft income tax treaty, marking the first such agreement between them. OECD: Slovenia extends BEPS MLI to tax treaty with Montenegro
items.summary: The OECD has published Slovenia’s consolidated MLI position on 15 September 2026. The update adds the 2003 Slovenia-Montenegro tax treaty, concluded with the former Serbia and Montenegro, as a covered agreement and makes corresponding changes to Slovenia’s MLI notifications and reservations.
